description: Cruise lines on Cruises Frog with their style, who they suit, fleet rating (the average of their ships' editorial scores), owner, ship count, solo cabins, and page link. Narrow by style, audience (e.g. families) or solo cabins and sort by rating to answer "best cruise line for ..." questions. For someone cruising alone, get_cruise_line has each line's single supplement and solo meetups, and https://cruisesfrog.com/solo-cruises compares them.

audience.description: Only lines that list this audience

region.description: Only lines with ships sailing this region (slug or name, from list_cruise_regions)

solo_cabins.description: Only lines with cabins built for one person: on every ship (fleetwide), on some ships, or either (any)

name: list_cruise_lines
title: Find cruise lines
